content: Water poured into an upside-down clay jug simply runs off the bottom and moistens the dust.
author: Persian Proverbs
explanation: You can stand before the greatest sage or read the holiest scriptures, but if your mind is inverted by arrogance and defensiveness, the water of wisdom runs off like rain on greasy leather. Turn your jug upright through humility, and you will be filled.
practicalInsight: Approach your work or studies today with the beginner's mind: empty of arrogance, eager to learn.
reflectionPrompt: Where are you standing with an 'upside-down jug', refusing to let valuable wisdom fill your life?
